title: adopt on a red base seeds a green-base task and a canary timeout names its slow step
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114d slice 4: census 3x exit 69 (red base: mise-en-plesk, lsn2-map, wycena-master) and 1x 124 (perfect-memory canary 180s).
Outcome: red base adopts in bootstrap state whose admitted task makes the base green; a canary timeout reports which step (install, test, Stop gate) exceeded and the measured time.
Proof: fixtures with red base and slow test; census 69 and 124 rows reach 0.
